title: Foreign Workers (Prohibition of Unlawful Employment and Assurance of Fair Conditions) Law, 5751-1991
amended: amended several times (consolidated English text undated)
source_tier: Secondary (UNHCR Refworld; unofficial English translation of a consolidated version)
site_status: NEW: add to national-laws (already cited in the domestic-workers database as Foreign Workers Law, 1991)
note: Checked on 2026-11-21 against the Refworld PDF supplied by IMR (unofficial English, consolidated with later amendments, date of consolidation not stated). Known as the Foreign Workers Law. In force 1 May 1991. Employer may employ a foreign worker only with a medical certificate, a written contract in a language the worker understands (s. 1C), medical insurance and suitable housing (s. 1D); deposits into a Foreign Workers Fund paid to the worker on departure (Chapter Four, s. 1K), with exemptions or reductions possible for nursing-care (caregiver) workers employed by individuals; offences and supervision in Chapter Five. Official Hebrew text to find on Nevo or the Knesset legislation database.
